Inner Network Community Guidelines

Effective Date: November 10, 2026 · Last updated: November 10, 2026 · Version 2026-11-10

Inner Network is for professionals who find, host, and attend business and wellness events. These guidelines summarize what we expect. Our Terms of Service have the full rules.

1. Be who you are

Use your real name and accurate job and company details. Do not impersonate people or organizations, or claim a listing you do not represent.

2. Be respectful

No harassment, threats, hate, or sexually explicit content. Keep messages relevant to professional networking.

3. Host real events

Hosted events must be real business or wellness events, described accurately. Show your refund policy before selling tickets, and refund everyone if you cancel. Nightlife, dating, and party events are not allowed.

4. Invite people the right way

Only add guests who would expect to hear from you. Do not upload purchased or scraped lists, and never text anyone who has opted out.

5. Honest reviews and vouches

Review only events you attended, and give vouches only when you mean them. Do not trade vouches or reviews.

6. Safe links

Do not use link in bio pages, card links, or QR codes to hide where a link goes, phish, or spread malware.

7. Respect people's data

Use contacts, leads, and notes only for your own networking. Do not record sensitive information about others, and honor requests to stop or delete.

8. Reporting and appeals

Use Report on any profile, event, organizer, message, or page, or email contact@innernetwork.app. If we remove your content or limit your account, you can reply to our notice within 30 days to ask for a second review.
